title: Fast CTest selector for DWG CLASSES string-footer boundaries
scope: Expose the existing generated AC1024 high-bit class string-footer and extended-prefix controls as an independently runnable CTest.
controlCoverage: The existing selector includes an in-memory AC1024 file with three 2048-character class strings, verifies the class string footer exceeds 0x7fff bits, reads the strings back through readDwgClasses(), and checks high-bit footer arithmetic and bounds.
claimBoundary: Generated wire-boundary regression evidence only. The provenance-qualified AutoCAD 2010 RTM discrepancy remains unresolved; this selector does not establish producer interoperability or AC1024 support.
fixturePolicy: No DWG/DXF fixture added. The control generates its input in memory.
